text_block_list.text:
Our fulfilling summer training camp with Tokai Teio
comes to an end today—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Ow, ow, ow... Just because it was the last day of training camp,
I pushed myself too hard and now I'm super sore."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all and focused so hard
that I don't have any regrets left!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is the Japan Cup—
I'll throw everything I have into it."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll show all my fans and the President
just how much I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ow-ow-ow-ow.
These sore muscles are ruining my cool pose~!
